# Ssr attributes

Every attribute declared by `Ssr`, with the signature the code has and a usage quoted from the codebase.

## `#[AsComponent]`

`Semitexa\Ssr\Attribute\AsComponent`

Applies to: class

| parameter | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes |
| `template` | `string` | no |
| `layout` | `string` | no |
| `cacheable` | `bool` | no |
| `event` | `string` | no |
| `triggers` | `array` | no |
| `script` | `string` | no |

```php
#[AsComponent(
    name: 'product-spotlight-card',
    template: '@shop/components/product-spotlight-card.html.twig',
    script: 'shop:js:product-spotlight-card',
)]
final class ProductSpotlightCardComponent
```
